summary.intent: Use GSD manager to discuss and plan the final 2 phases (38 and 39) of milestone v1.1, then fix a flashing progress bar bug discovered during the session.
summary.outcome: Phase 38 and 39 context captured with full decisions, Phase 38 planning completed (4 plans, 2 waves), Phase 38 execution and Phase 39 planning spawned as background agents, and the inline upload progress bar flash fixed via CSS-only shimmer approach.

repo: SDK migration pattern is established: hooks import SDK methods directly and pass store-extracted state as explicit params (useSharedWriteOps.ts is the canonical example).
folder.service.ts (1,059 LOC) and bin.service.ts (971 LOC) are the two deprecated web services to retire in Phase 38; SDK equivalents already exist in packages/sdk and packages/sdk-core.
packages/crypto has a circular devDependency on @cipherbox/core because vault-ipns.test.ts imports deriveRegistryIpnsKeypair and initializeVault — fix is to replace with hardcoded test vectors.
Three utility functions (addFileToFolder, addFilesToFolder, replaceFileInFolder) have no SDK equivalent yet and need extraction to @cipherbox/sdk-core as part of Phase 38.
purgeExpired has no public SDK method — needs to be added to CipherBoxClient.
CipherBoxClient.getContext() exists at client.ts:312, enabling SdkContext bridging for caller migration.
User vault settings (e.g., BYO-IPFS config) are stored in encrypted vault metadata on IPFS — ByoIpfsConfig in packages/core/src/vault/types.ts is the proven pattern to follow for Phase 39.
Bin retention is currently a server-side env var (RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS); Phase 39 moves it to client-controlled vault metadata, deprecating the env var.
Settings page has 3 tabs (Linked Methods, Security, Storage); Phase 39 adds a 4th 'Vault' tab.
Max versions hardcoded as MAX_VERSIONS_PER_FILE=10 in file-metadata.service.ts and sdk-core/src/file/index.ts; version cooldown hardcoded as VERSION_COOLDOWN_MS=15min.

code.finding: Encrypting state used width: 100% !important on the fill bar, causing a flash when first progress event arrived and snapped to 0%. Fixed by using shimmer on track with fill hidden (opacity: 0) during encrypting, fading in at real progress when uploading starts.
ByoIpfsConfig type stored in encrypted vault metadata — canonical pattern for user-configurable vault settings in Phase 39.
CipherBoxClient.getContext() enables SdkContext bridging for service-to-SDK caller migration.

workflow: GSD manager can parallelize: discuss a phase inline while another plans in background, then spawn executor and next planner together after discuss completes.
Background planners may finish on a different branch than the context branch (planner committed to docs/phase-38-plan instead of docs/phase-38-context) — branch reconciliation needed post-execution.
Quick bug fixes during a manager session should be committed to a separate fix branch rather than the planning/feature branch to keep history clean.
When stashing during a fix branch checkout, unrelated executor changes can contaminate the stash — selectively stage only the target file before committing.

friction: Phase 38 planner committed artifacts to docs/phase-38-plan instead of docs/phase-38-context, requiring branch reconciliation later.
When creating the fix branch for the CSS bug, stashing pulled in unrelated Phase 38 executor changes, requiring selective staging to isolate the fix.
Screen recording could not be directly viewed (binary file), requiring code-first investigation of the flash bug instead of visual confirmation.
open_items: Phase 38 execution (migrate callers, delete services, fix circular dep) is running in background — outcome unknown.
Phase 39 planning is running in background — outcome unknown.
Branch reconciliation needed: docs/phase-38-plan and docs/phase-38-context branches need to be merged/resolved after execution completes.
Server-side RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS env var deprecation (Phase 39) — needs migration notice or deprecation warning for self-hosters.
Phase 39 spec: 0 max versions means no version history, 0 retention means purge immediately — edge case behavior for these zero values should be validated during planning.
Upload progress bar CSS fix was committed but not yet tested against the actual screen recording scenario.
